reviews.title: Great Workout Programming + Annoying Notifications
reviews.text:
First, the positive: The app’s workout programming and UI are phenomenal. 

Now, the negative: The “Tip of the Day” notifications are annoying as **** and I can’t for the life of me figure out how to turn them off. Not kidding, I get multiple an hour! It’s maddening. In the “notifications” area of the menu, I have tried setting the frequency to “Light” (workout time reminders only) and “Never”, neither of which mitigated the onslaught of notifications. Aside from turning off notifications for the app entirely, I’m at a loss of what to do. 

It’s a shame, because I love everything else about the app.

reviews.title: Pretty solid! Wish it had RIR, tho.
reviews.text:
Hi! The app is amazing, has a BUNCH of exercises to choose from, technique cues, can record sets reps, adjust rest period and so many things. It’s great. Even with the free option you can do an amazing and full workout.
Tho the “Supersets” functionality is limited on the free version, which is expected.

My main critique is that I wish we could also record RIR/RPE in our sets, since many people like me use them. They would be very useful at reflecting when in an exercise even with the same weight and reps it feels easier to do, which is also progress. 

Aside from that, I can’t complain too much. The translation, particularly into Spanish, is slightly deficient in some aspects, but gets the job done. I would suggest hiring a professional translator if it hasn’t been done. 

Anyway. I highlight how good the free version is, the pro prices are not bad whatsoever. And it has an entire section to track weight, height, and numerous body measurements all for free! I’d pretty much recommend it to anyone that hits the gym and wants a great app overall. Especially considering how user-friendly it is and all its free functionalities. Kudos to y’all, and hope some of the disadvantages can be improved in the future! ✌️
